principles: The build pipeline owns the executable bit of what it emits; nothing outside the build should have to remember chmod.
A no-op when there is nothing to restore; never change dist content, only mode bits.
Doctor states realpath, version and mode as facts and prints the exact remediation, it never repairs the host itself.
One committed red test pins the property so the regression cannot return silently.
drivers: Every real rebuild today breaks the global command with permission denied (RED run4-global-cli.txt).
npm link chmods once; tsc never sets exec bits; promotion is a rename so the new inode carries 0644.
The draft symptom of the link pointing into another worktree is only visible to an operator running doctor.

options.name: promote-restores-bits
pros: Single place shared by main and utils builds
Proven by the GREEN candidate patch

options.name: postbuild-npm-script
cons: Only runs when the npm script is the entry; direct node scripts/build-main-with-binding.mjs invocations (bin/bootstrap-runner.js) would still emit 0644

options.name: wrapper-only
pros: Route every global call through bin/proof-or-stop.js which spawns node explicitly
cons: Does not fix the published bin target that npm link points at; changes the install story

rationale: promote-restores-bits fixes the property at the only place every rebuild passes through, is already proven GREEN by the candidate patch, and keeps the crash-safe promotion untouched; the other options leave at least one real invocation path emitting a non-executable bin target.

preMortem.scenario: chmod changes the build binding digest or the content-bound skip check
preMortem.trigger: verifyBuildBinding fails right after a build because file mode is part of the digest
preMortem.consequence: Every build rebuilds twice or the fast path never skips
preMortem.mitigation: Check full-suite-build-binding.mjs digests content only; add a case to the red test that a second build verifies (skips) after the chmod

preMortem.scenario: Absent bin target on a first or partial build throws inside promoteDist
preMortem.trigger: fresh checkout builds with no dist/cli.js yet
preMortem.mitigation: restoreBinExecutableBits swallows ENOENT per target and returns the restored list; a fixture proves the no-op path

preMortem.scenario: Doctor global-cli row false-alarms on machines without a global install
preMortem.trigger: no proof-or-stop on PATH or realpath outside any repo
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse checkGlobalCoreRealpath classification: absent global install stays informational, only a resolvable-but-wrong realpath or non-executable target warns
